summary: SKK Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing six new Singapore contracts worth up to US$26.6 million for its subsurface utility subsidiary. This is routine business development, not a special situation. The text also mentions a previously approved US$258.8 million acquisition of Rantizo's drone assets, but that transaction was announced and approved earlier; this filing does not report a new event related to that deal. No deal terms of a special-situation nature are stated here. The filing is a standard operational update, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
